notes: Declared thresholds for the P5 technical and musical audio checks (R4). Loaded and validated by quality_gate.audio.policy.load_audio_qa_policy; no threshold lives in evaluator code.

policy_version is stamped on every technical check (config_version), every musical check (model_version), the audio_measurements evidence item and the evaluator results, so a decision can be replayed against the exact thresholds that produced it. Change any value only together with a new policy_version.
Measurement methods are documented in quality_gate/audio/measure.py. A measurement that cannot be made is UNKNOWN with a reason and is a blocking finding; it never passes.

decode.source: Non-WAV inputs are decoded to 32-bit float PCM by ffmpeg; WAV (RIFF/RF64/BW64) is read by libsndfile. A decode that exceeds the timeout is a blocking DECODE_FAILED.

format.source: The P4 mock and the C3 default delivery profile are 44.1 kHz stereo. A deviation is a recorded LOW-severity variance, not a rejection (P5 plan section 14).

loudness.method: ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated loudness (K-weighting, 400 ms blocks, 75 % overlap, -70 LUFS absolute and -10 LU relative gates) via pyloudnorm
loudness.source: -14 LUFS is the YouTube/Spotify normalisation reference; target and tolerance are the values the evaluator previously took as parameters, moved here unchanged. Deviation beyond tolerance is a LOW warning, beyond tolerance + escalation a MEDIUM warning (P5 plan section 15: a quality signal, not a universal release rule).

true_peak.source: ITU-R BS.1770-4 Annex 2 (4x oversampling). -1 dBTP is the common streaming delivery ceiling. Above the ceiling is a LOW warning; above 0 dBTP (inter-sample over) a MEDIUM warning. It does not block: P6 renders through loudness normalisation, and sample-domain clipping is judged separately below.

clipping.source: A clip event is a run of at least min_run_samples consecutive samples in one channel at or above full_scale_dbfs (16-bit full scale 32767/32768 is -0.0003 dBFS). A single near-full-scale sample is not an event (P5 plan section 16). block_min_events or more events is the blocking CLIPPING_DETECTED.

silence.source: A frame is silent when its peak over all channels is below threshold_dbfs. Edge silence beyond the maxima is a MEDIUM warning (P5 plan section 17: silence can be intentional). A file with no frame at or above the threshold is the blocking TOTAL_SILENCE_DETECTED.

stereo.source: Whole-file phase correlation of L and R (sum(L*R)/sqrt(sum(L^2)*sum(R^2))). A negative whole-file value is a MEDIUM warning; at or below the block value the mono fold-down largely cancels (near mono-inverted content), which blocks (P5 plan section 18).

dynamics.source: Crest factor (sample peak dBFS minus RMS dBFS) as a quality signal, not a release rule (P5 plan section 19). Values moved unchanged from the previous evaluator.

musical_scoring.source: Heuristic composite of the loudness and dynamics signals; weights moved unchanged from the previous evaluator. The loudness score is 1 - |measured - target| / loudness_score_span_lu, clamped to [0, 1].
